name: unic-agentic-kit
description: Unic Claude Code marketplace. Hosts unic (autopilot + PR review/respond skills and the autopilot worker agents), dor-dod, and flowlever.

plugins.name: unic
plugins.description: autopilot (autonomous plan → build → review → fix loop), pr-review and pr-respond (Azure DevOps PRs), the autopilot-builder/reviewer/fixer agents, and the conventions they cite.

plugins.name: dor-dod
plugins.description: Specification & dev toolkit on the FZAG DXP Definition of Ready/Done: spec (author a story/bug/feature spec to the relevant DoR as markdown), check (audit any artifact against the matching DoR/DoD), and promote (publish a draft to an Azure DevOps work item or Confluence page). One shared source-of-truth checklist; works with or without MCP.

plugins.name: flowlever
plugins.description: Local review cockpit for specs and PR review/respond: a fingerprinted findings ledger that tracks issues across audit rounds, a guided review-flow stepper, exportable work orders, and UI-triggered jobs. Bundles a zero-dependency Node app plus /flowlever:* skills.
